pooling: float32 attention-mask-aware mean, then L2 normalization (src.models.pooling.masked_mean_pool)
normalization: float64 copy: z = h / ||h||_2; originals untouched

formulas.uniformity: log(mean(exp(-2*||z_i-z_j||^2))) over unique unordered article pairs

pair_definition: Different ideology and nonempty intersection of event memberships; each article pair counted once
row_order_verification: Declared shared extraction order, metadata IDs, source indices and shapes checked; arrays have no embedded IDs, so arbitrary internal permutations cannot be independently detected.

bootstrap.uniformity: Article bootstrap, stratified when sampling is stratified; repeated article copies have zero distance
bootstrap.alignment: Positive-pair bootstrap; conditional on sampled pairs; shared articles/events cause dependence not captured by this simple interval

wandb.reason: Enable explicitly with --wandb; no login required.
